en: The image is a black-and-white photograph of a picturesque riverside castle or palace. The structure features tall, pointed spires, fortified stone towers, crenellated walls, arched gateways, and ornate architectural details. A footbridge crosses the water in front of the entrance, and two people are rowing a small boat on the waterway. The overall style is reminiscent of European neo-Gothic castles.
